page.title: Flarumverse
page.intro: New discussions from forums paired with {forum}. Each one opens on the forum it was posted on.
page.empty: No discussions from paired forums yet.

directory.title: Find a forum
directory.intro: Independent communities running on Flarum. Each one is run by its own owners. Click one to visit and join.
directory.list_yours: Run a Flarum forum? Install Flarumverse and tick "List my forum" to appear here.

pair.heading: Pair with a forum
pair.label: Forum address
pair.sent: Request sent to {name}. It shows here as paired once they approve.

suggestions.heading: Suggested
suggestions.help: A good first partner. Nothing is sent until you click Send request, and they approve each request.

sections.none_paired: Not paired with any forum yet.

partner.threads: {count, plural, one {# discussion} other {# discussions}} on your Flarumverse page
partner.unreachable: Can't reach this forum at the moment ({error}). Flarumverse keeps trying.
partner.confirm_remove: Stop pairing with {name}? Each forum stops showing the other's discussions.

directory.heading: Flarumverse directory
directory.help: List your forum on {host}/forums, where people looking for a community browse forums by topic and language. Your forum's name, description, number of members and discussions, and its three newest discussion titles are shown. Every listing is approved by hand first.
directory.listed: List my forum in the directory
directory.logo_bg_help: Pick what your logo was drawn to sit on, so it stays readable on your directory card.

status.approved: Listed. Your forum is in the directory.

listings.heading: Directory listings
listings.help: Forums asking to be listed on this forum's /forums page. Only approved forums are shown there.
listings.none: No forums have asked to be listed yet.

items.shared: Only discussions a guest could read are shared, never private, hidden or restricted ones.
items.sent: Each discussion shares its title, the first few lines, the author's name, its tag and the reply count.
items.refresh: Flarumverse refreshes every partner every 15 minutes through Flarum's scheduler. With a queue worker running, new discussions are sent the moment they're posted.

api.invalid_address: Enter the forum's web address, like forum.example.com. It must use https.
api.not_a_flarumverse_forum: That forum doesn't have Flarumverse installed, or couldn't be reached.
api.request_failed: The forum didn't accept the request. Try again later.
api.declined_recently: That forum declined a request from you recently.
api.they_are_full: That forum already has as many partners as it can.
api.they_are_busy: That forum is getting a lot of requests. Try again tomorrow.
api.we_are_full: You already have {max} partners, the most Flarumverse allows.
api.directory_pick: Choose a topic and a language for your listing.
api.directory_failed: The directory couldn't be reached. Try again later.
